allow: PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c | Select-Object -First 1 LocalPort, OwningProcess; Get-Process -Id $c[0].OwningProcess | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path } else { 'port 5000 free' })

PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 11476 | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path; try { \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/api/settings/global' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5\).Content.Substring\(0, 300\) } catch { "API check failed: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
